purpose: Controlled probing of known semantic failure modes / decision boundaries. NOT a real-world distribution and NOT a generalisation claim.

A_technology_adjacency.probe_expectation: adjacent tech must NOT be upgraded to Partial → expected Missing
examples: req fine-tuning-training / evidence only API app
req rec-search / evidence only generic AI

B_project_vs_formal_work.probe_expectation: years/formal-tenure gates → eligibility PotentialGap/Unknown (not converted from projects); hands-on-delivery asks → project can support Strong; formal-role-scope asks → Partial

C_strong_partial_boundary.probe_expectation: meaningful but materially incomplete evidence → expected Partial

D_partial_missing_boundary.probe_expectation: only weak / adjacent evidence → expected Missing (Partial must not be an uncertainty bucket)

E_or_alternative.probe_expectation: one explicitly-allowed branch satisfied → expected Strong (not Missing because other branches unmet)

F_compound.probe_expectation: narrowest unmet subclaim governs → expected Partial. MONITORING cases, not prompt-tuning targets.

G_role_core_mismatch.probe_expectation: role core is non-AI → core reqs Missing; AI mention → subjective / non-scoring. Tests over-reaction to AI keywords + role_family classification.

gt_method: SCENARIO-DERIVED. Each label is fixed by the controlled scenario rule applied to the REAL frozen candidate evidence profile (pilot_v2 human-verified). No matcher was asked to judge its own JD. Every matchable requirement carries expected_match_label + gt_rationale referencing the evidence configuration; eligibility carries Supported/PotentialGap/Unknown.
leakage_controls: synthetic metrics MUST NOT be merged with V2-Real metrics or reported as real-world generalisation
fictional employers only; no real company names
no finalist model inference; set must be frozen (after human review) before any prediction
no new real-candidate achievements invented; scenarios encoded relative to the frozen evidence catalogue
